throughline.zh: 本週半導體產業呈現差異化的營運階段：旺宏記憶體及力成 FOPLP 擴產尚有量產時程，精測和晶豪科揭露第三季實績，泰國與新加坡的設備、電力和海纜計畫各有不同核准進度。
throughline.en: This week reveals distinct stages: Macronix memory and Powertech FOPLP ramps are future targets, CHPT and ESMT published Q3 results, and equipment, power and connectivity projects in Thailand and Singapore remain at different execution stages.

title.zh: 記憶體、電子材料與稀土供應
title.en: Memory, electronics materials and rare earths

summary.zh: 工研院規劃稀土示範廠，騰輝在泰國啟用銅箔基板廠，旺宏說明新增 NAND／eMMC 產能預計 2027 年下半年開出；晶豪科則公布第三季記憶體財務實績。上述資訊分別屬未來目標、已啟用廠房與已認列收入。
summary.en: ITRI described a rare-earth demonstration target and Tenghui opened a Thai laminate plant, while Macronix targets H2 2027 new NAND/eMMC output and ESMT reported Q3 earnings. These are planned capacity, opened facilities and realized financial results.

title.zh: 工廠設備、製程量測與自動化
title.en: Factory equipment, process metrology and automation

summary.zh: 台電公布颱風復電進度，鴻海與 NVIDIA 報告特定流程效率，中華電信成立智慧影像子公司；國研院與汎銓公布 High-NA EUV 樣品檢測方法，宏偉聲稱特殊工業電梯訂單能見度達三年。製造效率、技術開發與接單指標不能等量比較。
summary.en: Taipower restored power after a typhoon, Foxconn/NVIDIA reported measured workflow changes and Chunghwa Telecom launched a vision subsidiary. NARLabs/MSS presented a high-NA EUV metrology method and Hongwei reported three years of specialized-lift backlog visibility; these are different metrics.

title.zh: 東南亞電源與資料中心基礎設施
title.en: Southeast Asian power and data-center infrastructure

summary.zh: MViSTA 海纜仍在供應商招標，馬來西亞總理談及大型資料中心投資意向，新加坡 EMA 另有條件核准 1.3GW 跨境電力計畫；台達電泰國子公司公告向集團新加坡公司取得設備。跨境電力核准、投資意向及關係人資產取得都不能視為已裝機容量。
summary.en: MViSTA remains in tender, Malaysia's prime minister cited an investment intention, and Singapore EMA granted conditional 1.3GW power-import approval. Delta Thailand approved an intragroup equipment acquisition, none of which independently establishes live data-center capacity.

title.zh: 封裝測試、光互連與高科技設備供應
title.en: Packaging, optical interconnect and equipment supply

summary.zh: 玉晶光與 3M 光互連合作尚無已驗收量產數據，長榮航說明高科技貨運需求，ASMPT 的 SMT 事業出售仍在洽談；力成新公布先進封裝營收占比逾三成，中華精測公布晶圓測試卡帶動的第三季實績。FOPLP 的 2027 年量產目標仍與現有封測收入分開。
summary.en: GSEO/3M's optical interconnect remains unqualified at volume, EVA Air discussed cargo and ASMPT's SMT sale remains under review. Powertech reports over 30% advanced packaging revenue and CHPT Q3 results reflect probe-card sales, while FOPLP's 2027 ramp is still prospective.

title.zh: 晶圓設計、製造專案與跨境合作
title.en: Wafer design, fab development and cross-border cooperation

summary.zh: 台菲經濟走廊合作仍屬政策方向，Reuters 指越南 Viettel 晶圓廠工程與 DUV 採購未完成；智原 10 月 27 日公布與三星及聯電相關的美國 2 奈米 GAA 設計案。晶片委託設計、晶圓廠建造與量產出貨是不同執行階段。
summary.en: Philippine semiconductor corridors remain policy discussions and Reuters reported uncompleted Viettel fab construction and DUV sourcing. Faraday announced a U.S. 2nm GAA design project with Samsung and UMC partnerships; design work, fab building and volume production are separate stages.
